_audience: Downstream consumers (DB writers, validators, integrators) and operators auditing the extraction pipeline. Not directly consumed by the agent at runtime — the agent's contract lives in SKILL.md and the JSON schemas. Linked from SKILL.md "Reference index".
_purpose: Stable contract documenting which actor (agent / scaffolder / normalize / runtime) owns which artifact, plus the public-output rules a final brandkit.json must satisfy.

assemblerModes.scaffold: Generate a shape-safe candidate extraction-stage draft and assembly-diagnostics.json from saved homepage artifacts.
assemblerModes.normalize: Validate, sanitize, canonicalize known aliases, and refresh diagnostics for an agent-authored draft passed with --input <path>.

rules: Extraction owns homepage evidence and non-voice public fields only.
Use --mode scaffold after homepage-pass.js as a candidate extraction-stage draft.
The assembler generates a shape-safe candidate draft and diagnostics; it does not own brand role decisions.
The agent owns role decisions from saved screenshot, DOM hierarchy, and focused probe evidence, and decides which candidate records survive into brandkit.extraction.json.
Use --mode normalize --input <path> after agent edits; normalize validates, sanitizes, canonicalizes, and diagnoses only.
Extraction-stage public fields copied unchanged by runtime must use the same shape as final schema.
Runtime merges brand-voice into extraction output and validates final schema.
Product-card evidence is neutral evidence under brand.components.productCard.
No public field may contain worker-local paths, selectors, debug traces, screenshots, coordinates, DOM ids, or DOM classes.
